chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Yahya ibn al-Hasan ibn Ja'far ibn Ubaydullah ibn al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn Abi Talib narrated to us. He said: Yahya ibn al-Husayn ibn Ja'far narrated to me. He said: A shaykh from the people of Yemen named Abdullah ibn Muhammad narrated to me. He said: I heard Abd al-Razzaq say:

A handmaid of Ali ibn al-Husayn (peace be upon them both) was pouring water upon him while he was making ablution for prayer. The pitcher fell from the hand of the handmaid upon his face, scraping him.

Ali ibn al-Husayn (peace be upon them both) raised his head toward her. The handmaid said: "Surely God the Mighty and Majestic says: 'and those who restrain their anger.'" He said to her: "I have restrained my anger." She said: "'and those who pardon the people.'" He said: "God has forgiven you." She said: "'and God loves the doers of good.'" He said: "Go, for you are free."
ai.seo_question: How did Imam Zayn al-Abidin demonstrate the three Quranic virtues from Surah Al Imran 3:134?
ai.summary: Imam Ali ibn al-Husayn (Zayn al-Abidin) demonstrated the Quranic virtues of restraining anger, pardoning, and doing good in a single incident. When his handmaid accidentally injured him with a water pitcher during ablution, she progressively recited the three parts of Quran 3:134, and the Imam embodied each virtue in response, culminating in freeing her.
